oil.when: 2021 with the steering-wheel arrow and OK buttons
steps: Reset only after the oil and filter have actually been changed.
Turn the ignition on and open the main menu in the instrument cluster with the steering-wheel arrow buttons.
Scroll to Settings and press the right arrow, then scroll to Vehicle and press the right arrow.
Scroll to Oil Life, then press and hold OK while the cluster shows Hold OK to Reset.
Let go when it shows Reset Successful and oil life reads 100%. If it shows Not Reset or Reset Cancelled, go through the steps again.
Set all four tires to the cold pressure on the driver's door jamb sticker.
Drive above 20 mph for at least two minutes. The light should go out by itself.
If the tires are set correctly, the spare is not in use, and the light stays on, have the system checked.
tpms.note: If the light flashes for about a minute at start-up and then stays on, the system has a fault that adding air will not fix. The manual also calls for a system reset after every tire rotation; ask the tire shop or dealer to do it.

notes: Edge uses a calculated oil life reminder, so it will not clear itself after an oil change.
